page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8t.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal host instance provisioned via KVM virtualization. It features 128 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The server contains 1024 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB memory allocation per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by 8 NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs delivering a total combined VRAM capacity of 192 GB.

Networking capabilities are defined by a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 170 Gbps, supporting efficient inter-node data exchange in distributed deployment scenarios. The server includes zero local storage, requiring persistent storage to be attached remotely over the network. This infrastructure configuration prioritizes accelerator and core density, trading off local disk drives for high-capacity remote volumes.

Given the combination of 8 NVIDIA GPUs, 128 dedicated CPU cores, 1 TB of system RAM, and 170 Gbps network bandwidth, this instance is suited for deep learning model training, AI inference execution, computer vision tasks, and large-scale data science pipelines.
